title: An Algebra of Observables for de Sitter Space
version: arXiv:2206.10780v5, 3 July 2023; pages 1-2, 4-5, 7, 10-11, 13-14, 17, 19-20, 53 read through a page extraction
locator: Sec. 2.1 (static patch, complementary patch, commutant); Sec. 2.3 (timelike tube theorem and the observer's worldline, with footnote 4); Sec. 1.2 (quotation on knowledge beyond the horizon); Sec. 2.5 (Local Group remark)
assumptions: Quantum fields on a fixed de Sitter background for the statements used; additive algebras.
conclusion: Authors' statements used: the algebra of a thin neighbourhood of an observer's worldline equals the static patch algebra; the complementary patch algebra is its commutant; the observer has no knowledge of a global state.
proof_status: The statements used are recalled by the authors from the timelike tube theorem, with a footnote noting that the curved-spacetime case was at the time proved for free fields in analytic spacetimes. Not re-derived.
relevance: Quantum mirror of the horizon case.
limits: The paper's main results on the Type II algebra with gravity were not used and mostly not read.
